# criterion domain

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:criterionDomain`](gmeow-criterionDomain.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/criterionDomain>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The subject domain(s) of this criterion. NOT functional: a criterion may span domains, and classifications coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a criterion's subject domain(s) via the [`gmeow:CriterionDomain`](../classes/gmeow-CriterionDomain.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single domain (it is non-functional — a criterion may span domains and classifications coexist) and avoid minting a domain subclass.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:criterionDomain`](gmeow-criterionDomain.md) at one or more [`gmeow:CriterionDomain`](../classes/gmeow-CriterionDomain.md) individuals; competing classifications of one criterion coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
